Ana: Heads-up — we need a lean refresh of the competitor soundpack + battlecard ahead of next week's webinar. Focus: benchmark narrative, routing plays vs cloud AI providers, and one-pager rebuttals for sales.
Marcus: Agree. Can we tighten the p95 / cost-per-1000 token lines — customers eat simple numbers.
Sylvie: I'll draft 3 headline hooks: latency-first, predictable-cost, private-deploy advantage. Quick A/B phrasing for slides.
Jonah: For benchmarks: let's call out identical prompt, same hardware family where possible. Add a short note about fallback routing behavior.
Ana: @Sylvie love the hooks. Marcus — can you pull the latest p95 and tokens metrics from the infra run? Need numbers we can cite.
ops-bot: infra-run-3101 completed by runner-03. Summary: p50=45ms, p95=128ms, avg cost per 1k tokens=$0.035, routing fallback rate=0.6%. Full log: https://internal/bench/3101
Marcus: Copying numbers. Will add a 1-sentence methodology: "identical prompts, same sequence length distribution, tested across NVIDIA A100 & Ampere-equivalent cloud instances."
Ana: Sales needs two quick rebuttals vs "cloud-hosted managed endpoints": (1) When to pick dedicated vs hosted, (2) fallback guarantees & SLA language. Keep each one 1-2 bullets.
Sylvie: I'll write the rebuttals and 3 soundbites for SDRs — short emotive + factual lines. Example: "Keep latency predictable without vendor lock — pin model versions and route for cost/latency."
Jonah: Also a tiny diagram for routing: primary (low-latency), secondary (cost-optimized), tertiary (fallback compatible). I'll mock in Figma and share link by EOD.
Marcus: One more ask — update the battlecard quick table comparing: latency SLO, unit cost, private deploy support, fallback rate. Use the ops-bot numbers for ours, estimate comparable public ranges for others (label as vendor-provided or bench-estimate).
Ana: Perfect. Owners: Sylvie (messaging + SDR soundbites), Marcus (bench numbers + table), Jonah (diagram + webinar slide). Deadline: Tuesday 09:00 PT for review. Reactions if you see this: :eyes:  
Sylvie: :thumbsup: got it, will push a draft by Monday night.
Marcus: :rocket: pulling numbers now.
Jonah: :white_check_mark: mock coming tonight.
